subject: Finalize joint marketplace demo time & runbook for EdgeScale x Redwood + AWS
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@edgescale.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + joint marketplace demo (EdgeScale x Redwood + AWS)

Hi Rafael,

Great to connect at the partner summit last week — EdgeScale would like to move forward with a co-sell marketplace demo that showcases our managed data connectors + Redwood inference in an AWS Marketplace flow.

High level ask: can we schedule a 45-minute joint demo with Redwood + an AWS GTM/solutions rep to walk through the listing, procurement flow, and a short live demo of an LLM-based inference pipeline? We want to record the session for the marketplace listing.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2027-03-09: 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2027-03-10: 11:00–11:45
- Thu 2027-03-11: 09:00–09:45

Attaching a short intro deck on EdgeScale and our marketplace listing draft (edgescale-intro.pdf).

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (SE, partner sales, and a product demo owner)? Also tagging Camila since she handles partner enablement.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Partnerships, EdgeScale Technologies
+1 415-555-0198
attachments: edgescale-intro.pdf
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@edgescale.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo (EdgeScale x Redwood + AWS)

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear options. Excited to run this with you.

Availability: the Wed 2027-03-10 11:00 PT slot works best for our team. If that aligns with AWS, we can lock it. If not, Rafael provided two backups below.

Redwood attendees we plan to include:
- Rafael Mendes (Partner Sales lead)
- Camila Reyes (Partner Enablement / demo lead)
- Sergio Alvarez (Marketplace sales / logistics)

We have a short runbook draft attached (redwood_cosell_runbook_v0.3.pdf) that outlines timing, recording permission, sandbox credentials, and customer-facing slides. Please review the demo checklist and call out any privacy or redaction needs for the recording.

Proposed backups (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-09 10:00
- Thu 2027-03-11 09:00

Can you confirm AWS representation (name/email) and whether EdgeScale will need us to present an integration walkthrough or just the listing + procurement flow?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 628-555-0102

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@edgescale.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + joint marketplace demo (EdgeScale x Redwood + AWS)

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 5:05 PM rafael.mendes@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Samir — thanks for the clear options. Excited to run this with you.
>
> Availability: the Wed 2027-03-10 11:00 PT slot works best for our team. If that aligns with AWS, we can lock it.

Thanks Rafael — good to hear. I checked with our AWS GTM contact (Priya Shah) and she confirmed the 2027-03-10 11:00 PT slot is okay for an AWS rep to join.

EdgeScale will also bring our SE, Maya Ortiz (maya.ortiz@edgescale.com), who will do a 10-minute walkthrough of the connector setup. We expect the agenda to be: 1) 5m intros, 2) 10m marketplace procurement flow (Redwood + AWS), 3) 15m EdgeScale integration demo, 4) 15m Q&A and next steps.

A couple of asks before we finalize:
- Can Redwood confirm whether recording is OK and whether we should redact any customer identifiers?
- Camila, can you share the exact marketplace listing URL and any test tokens we should use for the procurement demo?

If those are clear, we can lock the 03/10 11:00 PT time.

Cheers,
Samir

Locking the time on my side — I'll send the calendar invite to Priya and Samir once Rafael confirms final runbook.

Camila — can you prep the marketplace listing link + sanitized demo tokens (test account) by EOD tomorrow? We'll need a simple slide with buyer flow screenshots and the procurement checkout to show. If you want, I can loop in our AWS GTM contact directly on the runbook doc.

Thanks all — confirmed: Wed 2027-03-10 11:00–11:45 PT.

I've uploaded a finalized runbook (final_runbook_v1.pdf) with a minute-by-minute timeline, recording consent language, attendee roles, and fallback steps if the procurement sandbox fails. Recording is fine as long as we redact customer PII; runbook has the exact phrasing we'll read at the start.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=edgescale-redwood-20270310
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-2027-1147

Next steps (owner):
- Camila: supply listing URL + test tokens by EOD 2027-03-05 (owner: camila.reyes@redwood.com)
- Sergio: send calendar invite to Priya and Samir (owner: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com)
- Samir / Maya: confirm SE demo checklist and whether you need any extra sandbox access (owner: samir.khan@edgescale.com)

I'll also attach the runbook to the invite. Looking forward to a crisp session.

Best,
